content.what_it_is: MATLAB generator for the synthetic tide boundary-condition input of the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_frf_abc_data case. It defines an M2-like tidal period T=12.42*3600 s (L2), a time vector t=0:2000:96000 s (L3), a 1.0 m amplitude sinusoidal elevation z=1.0*sin(t/T*2*pi) (L4), and zero velocities u,v (L5-L6). It assembles columns (time, eta, u, v) into write_out, transposes it (L7-L11), and writes tide_data_west.txt (L13-L14) with a header line 'tide data (time,eta,u,v)' followed by rows formatted '%10.1f%10.4f%10.4f%10.4f' (L16-L17), closing the file at L19.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
T — tidal period in seconds, 12.42 h (L2)
t — time vector 0..96000 s step 2000 s (L3)
z — sinusoidal tidal elevation, amplitude 1.0 m (L4)
write_out — 4-column output matrix, transposed for fprintf (L7-L11)

equations.ref: sinusoidal tide elevation with period T and amplitude 1.0

unresolved: The 2000 s sampling step and 96000 s duration (L3) must match what the FUNWAVE-TVD tide boundary reader expects for this case (cf. the 26.6 hr axis in plot_time_series_less.m); the reader-side format contract is not in this file.
Amplitude 1.0 m and period 12.42 h (L2, L4) are a single-constituent idealization labeled only 'tide data'; whether it represents M2 specifically is implied by the period but not stated.
96000 s is not an integer multiple of T=44712 s, so the series ends mid-cycle; whether that matters to the run length is not determinable here.
